title: PITWALL
shortDescription: PITWALL is a React/Vite/Capacitor Formula 1 companion with a server-owned OpenF1 live gateway, a clearly labelled historical replay fallback, and a canonical real-geometry pipeline for circuits, maps, and simulation.
highlights: Server-owned OpenF1 live gateway with secure WebSocket delivery to the frontend.
Explicit historical replay fallback when no live session is active.
Canonical circuit geometry pipeline for maps, stylised outlines, and lap markers.
Capacitor Android packaging for a native mobile build path.
